items.title: Big tech- and pharma-backed Iambic Therapeutics aims for $135m IPO
items.summary: A US listing for the oncology specialist continues a bumper year for biotech IPOs.

items.title: Roche’s Tecentriq snags FDA label expansion in type of colon cancer
items.summary: Tecentriq is now the first immunotherapy indicated for dMMR colon cancer specifically, which is often linked to a higher risk of progression after surgery.

items.title: Bio-Techne opens GMP small molecule facility in Bristol, UK
items.summary: Life science tools and diagnostics provider Bio-Techne Corporation has opened a new manufacturing facility in Bristol, UK, dedicated to GMP grade small molecules.

items.title: Biohaven partners with Ono in $100m IgG degrader deal
items.summary: Biohaven has entered into an exclusive regional collaboration and licensing agreement worth up to $100m with Ono Pharmaceutical for its MoDE pan IgG degrader portfolio.

items.title: Viatris makes foray into non-opioid pain space on $1.65bn Pacira buyout
items.summary: The non-opioid pain field is attracting interest as experts sound the alarm on dependency issues linked to long-term opioid-based pain management.
